maria (Customer): hitting 400 on /v1/call-tool when calling tool="summarizer". Error from API: "400 invalid tool args: invalid JSON (unexpected newline at position 87)". Worked earlier today. Posting the raw body I sent below so you can repro.

maria (Customer): ```
{
  "tool": "summarizer",
  "tool_args": {
    "text": "First line
Second line with emoji 😅",
    "mode": "short"
  }
}
```

erin (Support): thanks — can you paste the request_id from the response and the exact raw payload (curl -v or node fetch body)? also which SDK/runtime?

maria (Customer): request_id: req_2026_09_14_42. using node fetch and I was constructing the body with a template literal like this (oops):

maria (Customer): ```
// simplified example
const prompt = `First line
Second line with emoji 😅`
const body = `{"tool":"summarizer","tool_args":` + `{"text":"${prompt}","mode":"short"}` + `}`
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body })
```

maria (Customer): I realize now that I wasn't JSON.stringifying tool_args, I was splicing in a JS template literal. apologies.

erin (Support): no worries — this is a pretty common cause. The parser returns a generic invalid JSON error when it encounters an unescaped literal newline inside a JSON string. Quick workaround: JSON.stringify the tool_args or escape newlines as \n. Example curl that should work: 

erin (Support): ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call-tool \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tool":"summarizer","tool_args": {"text": "First line\nSecond line with emoji 😅","mode":"short"}}'
```

erin (Support): if you can switch to:

// JS
const body = JSON.stringify({ tool: 'summarizer', tool_args: { text: prompt, mode: 'short' } });
fetch(url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body });

that should avoid this class of errors.

tim (Runtime): looking at our logs for req_2026_09_14_42 — parser error is: "ToolArgParseError: unexpected token (newline) at pos 86". It fails before JSON.parse because the payload includes raw template literal insertion (unquoted JS backticks/newlines). Also saw a couple of emoji surrogate pairs that were fine, main problem is raw unescaped newline.

tim (Runtime): plan: add a clearer error code (tool_args_json_error) and a small validation hint that suggests using JSON.stringify or escaping \n; low-risk patch, aiming to ship EOD. For now, please use the workaround. Can you attach the full raw request (headers+body) and the trace_id if available?

maria (Customer): trace_id: trace_9b3f. attaching full raw curl output in case you need it.

ingest-bot: logs uploaded -> s3://redwood-support-logs/req_2026_09_14_42/trace_9b3f.txt

erin (Support): escalated to eng, created ticket INC-5423 with request_id and trace_id. linking logs above. engineer assigned: tim. ETA EOD for a clearer error + suggestion text in the API response.

maria (Customer): thanks — that workaround works for now. appreciate the quick follow-up :thumbsup:

erin (Support): closing the loop here; re-open if you see anything else.
